notes: «قال أبو عبد الله أو هشام بن حسان عن حفصة» is the compiler's remark (al-Bukhari's kunya) naming Hisham for the same Hafsa link: a variant group, not a route. The compiler is not written.
The final remark «رواه هشام بن حسان عن حفصة عن أم عطية» repeats the variant and adds no new name.
Umm ʿAtiyya is the shared last link of both groups.
